pages.text:
The USA's superweapon fires no missile: it charges a particle beam and sends it up to a satellite, which brings it down from orbit wherever it is aimed. A drum of white concrete on its own plate, eight emitters through its wall round a hexagonal pit, beside a control tower with a glazed cab and an operations building with two satellite dishes on its roof.

It takes **no ammunition**: give it power through its Energy Port and it **charges for 4 minutes** at 1,200 FE a tick (charging pauses without power). Charged, its **focusing column** rises out of the pit, its core aglow and arcs leaping to it from the emitters: it is **READY**. Aim it, arm it and press LAUNCH on a [Launch Computer](ordnance/launch_site), or arm and fire it with a [Laser Designator](ordnance/laser_designator).

**The beam.** After a 10 second countdown a beam goes up out of the pit into the sky; two seconds later it comes down from orbit on the target and **burns for 48 seconds**. It eats down into whatever it stands on, deeper the longer it lingers (a trench up to 8 blocks deep): roofs, trees and water go first, and only bedrock and obsidian stop it. Its trench's sides melt (rock to **slag**, sand to **glassed sand**, earth to **scorched earth**, glowing magma here and there in its bottom), fires catch round it and anything under it, from the sky down, is **vaporised**: no armour, shield or potion saves you.

**Steering it.** Whoever fired it steers the beam: keep your Laser Designator on the ground and it follows your spot at **three blocks a second**; let go and it holds where it was headed. A new aim from a Launch Computer turns it too. **The beam draws 1,000 FE a tick**: whatever powers it well enough to charge keeps it burning, and what the cannon holds lasts twenty seconds; cut its power, knock it out with an EMP or break it and the beam dies at once.

The Particle Uplink Cannon, facing its controller: a 15 by 15 pad of Launch Pads, the controller in the middle of its front edge and an Energy Port two to its left. At the front right, the uplink drum: a ring of Uplink Wall nine across and three high, eight Particle Emitters through its middle course, the Focusing Column in the middle of the pit inside it; keep the drum's inside clear to the top, where the beam goes up. At the left, the control tower: Uplink Wall 2 by 2 and nine high. Behind it, the operations building: a 6 by 4 block of Uplink Wall three high (its walls only).
